description: Source code for the 'MenuContent' SwiftUI view, defining the menu bar extra content for the OpenClaw macOS application, including UI components for connection status, microphone management, settings, and debug actions.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: A simple identifiable struct representing an audio input device with a UID and name.

methods.name: loadMicrophones
methods.description: Asynchronously loads available microphone devices, optionally forcing refresh, and updates state with detected microphones.

methods.name: filterAliveInputs
methods.description: Filters a list of microphone inputs, returning only those with alive device UIDs.

methods.name: presentDebugResult
methods.description: Displays a modal alert dialog with the result of a debug action, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: loadBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Loads the current state of whether browser control is enabled from persistent config.

methods.name: saveBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Saves the current enabled state for browser control into persistent config.

methods.name: buildAndSaveBrowserEnabled
methods.description: Builds the config dictionary, updates the browser enabled setting, and saves it.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Requests to open a specific settings tab and brings the app to foreground.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the configuration and URL of the dashboard and opens it in the default browser.

methods.name: healthStatus
methods.description: Computes and returns the current health status label and color based on activity and store states.

methods.name: heartbeatStatus
methods.description: Computes and returns the current heartbeat status label and color based on recent heartbeat events.
